item.title: Fetch
item.description: The Fetch server retrieves a given URL and converts its HTML into clean markdown sized for an LLM context window, with a start-index parameter so an agent can page through long documents in chunks. It’s one of the official reference servers in the modelcontextprotocol/servers repo.
